definitions.gloss: for a period of; over the span of
definitions.explanation: Suffix attaching to a time-unit phrase to express duration ('for X days/weeks/years'). Makes the time expression explicitly a span rather than a point in time.

examples.japanese: {三日|みっか}{間|かん}{休|やす}んだ。
{一週|いっしゅう}{間|かん}{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'll go on a trip for one week.

examples.japanese: {留学|りゅうがく}{中|ちゅう}の{三年|さんねん}{間|かん}は、{人生|じんせい}で{最|もっと}も{大切|たいせつ}な{時期|じき}だった。
examples.english: The three years I spent studying abroad were the most important period of my life.

notes:
Attaches to time-unit counters to mark a duration. Compare {十日|とおか} (the tenth of the month) vs. {十日|とおか}{間|かん} (for ten days).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {一週|いっしゅう}{間|かん}: for one week
- {三日|みっか}{間|かん}: for three days
- {十年|じゅうねん}{間|かん}: for ten years
- {数|すう}{時間|じかん}: for several hours
- {長|なが}い{間|あいだ}: for a long time (read あいだ, not かん)

USAGE:
Not used with point-in-time expressions ({三時|さんじ}, {月曜日|げつようび}). When the time unit already implies duration ({時間|じかん}, {年間|ねんかん}), {間|かん} is built in and not added again.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {間|あいだ}: interval; while — different reading, refers to the time/space between two points
